excluded: CN my_region overlay deliberately NOT shipped. A root-level module file (my_region/build.prop) makes hybrid_mount take its 'shallow overlay' path for /my_region: it mounts an overlay on /my_region and then bind-mounts a staging etc over /my_region/etc. ZygiskNext later unmounts module mounts inside the zygote/system_server namespace, exposing that staging etc, so /my_region/etc is EMPTY for system_server - confirmed by 'CustomizeStateHelper: No directory /my_region/etc/extension' and 'OplusAppConfigManager: No directory /my_region/etc/config' in the same process at the same instant. With /my_region/etc/config/app_v2.xml unreadable, the region <enable pkg=com.coloros.sceneservice priority=9> never enters enableMap, the my_stock <disable ... priority=10> survives reconciliation, and com.coloros.sceneservice is dropped from the PMS boot scan entirely ('locate /product/priv-app/SceneService/SceneService.apk ignored'). The overlay was also useless: init loads ro.* props before KernelSU mounts, and OsFeatureConfiguration read the extension XMLs at 08:18:32, before hybrid_mount applied overlays at 08:18:37.

activation.ums: The CN UMS is versionCode 16059006, the same as the OOS factory build, so the /data/app 17.17.0 export update (62f23876, preserved as vendor/rollback/UMS-17.17.0-active.apk) outranks it and must be removed with 'pm uninstall-system-updates com.oplus.pantanal.ums' before the overlay takes effect. Without the update, PMS scans the overlaid CN APK at the same path, so no version-code spoofing is involved.
activation.sceneservice: The CN SceneService is versionCode 17006000, above the OOS factory 17003004, and no /data/app update exists for it any more, so the overlay becomes active directly.
activation.why_cn_builds_are_required: The OOS builds lack the domestic paths. Active (export) UMS has no assets/calculate/ directory at all - no package_mapping_config.json, so no AMap (com.autonavi.minimap -> service 536878000) or Baidu map entry. OOS factory SceneService carries only META-INF/seedling-support_liteRelease.kotlin_module, while the CN build carries components-seedling-core_domesticRelease plus assets/TextIntentSeedling.upk.
